latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Activation Funnel Diagnostic skill.

- Diagnoses where users drop off in an activation funnel using step-level metrics and onboarding flow docs.
- Identifies and names the highest-drop-off step, providing context from user survey responses if available.
- Decides between removing friction or adding “positive friction” (guided steps) to address activation problems.
- Generates an activation-funnel-diagnosis.md report and a ranked list of growth experiment candidates.
- Supports channel-segmented funnel analysis to highlight differences across acquisition sources.
- Intended for growth/product teams seeking to improve activation rates and onboarding effectiveness.
